auth.note: A server with its API token switched on answers 401 to the model list; set key_env and url under [engine].

verified.notes: The OpenAI-compatible API plus LM Studio's own model list, GET /api/v1/models: its keys are the ids the chat route accepts, max_context_length is the context size, and type embedding is left out. Chat still goes to /v1/chat/completions. Any server that answers both routes this way is treated as this kind, which wins over the plain OpenAI kind because it checks more.
